snippet.title: Realms of Riddles: Wizards' Keep | Official Extended Trailer
snippet.description:
Realms of Riddles: Wizards'Keep, a first-person puzzle adventure game

- Solve interconnected escape-room puzzles
- Explore hidden worlds, portals and secrets
- Uncover the truth behind a cursed kingdom

Play the demo on Steam — June 11

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2659610/Realms_of_Riddles_WizardsKeep/
